perspectives.name: discovery-weak-signals
observations: Joby's autonomy platform had accumulated more than 400 flights and 800 automated flight hours before completing the 3,199-mile transcontinental demonstration.
The autonomy program is being exercised across commercial freight, emergency-response and defense-logistics contexts, widening optionality beyond the core eVTOL passenger thesis.

perspectives.name: expectations-execution
observations: Repeated flight-hour accumulation and the coast-to-coast demonstration strengthen technical-maturity evidence but do not substitute for FAA approval, production economics or commercial revenue.
Core execution still hinges on type certification and industrialization; autonomy is an additional capability path rather than proof the core commercialization gate is cleared.

risks: autonomy demonstration not equivalent to approval/revenue
unknowns: unit economics and achieved production rate
near-term financial effect of autonomy programs
